title: Expanded Antigen-Specific Elimination Assay to Measure Human CD8+ T Cell Cytolytic Potential
author: Collins, Olatotse, et al.
materials: Ultra-LEAF purified anti-CD3 antibody (clone OKT3, Biolegend, Cat# 317304)
EasySep CD4+ T cell isolation kit (StemCell Technologies, Cat# 17952)

steps.title: Isolate mononuclear cells
steps.instruction: Thaw cryopreserved blood or tissue mononuclear cells in 10 ml R10 containing 10 U/ml nuclease, centrifuge 800 RCF for 3 min, resuspend at 1–2 ×10⁶ cells/ml in R10, and rest overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂; alternatively, isolate fresh mononuclear cells by density‑gradient centrifugation and proceed directly.

steps.title: Allocate cells to pools
steps.instruction: Count viable cells and split them: use ~85 % (≈4–30 ×10⁶ cells) for the effector pool and ~15 % (≈1–6 ×10⁶ cells) for the target pool.

steps.title: Coat plate for target expansion
steps.instruction: Add 400 µl per well of 2 µg/ml anti‑CD3 in carbonate coating buffer to a non‑treated 24‑well plate, seal, and incubate overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Isolate CD4+ target cells
steps.instruction: From the target pool, isolate CD4⁺ T cells by negative‑selection kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol and count the recovered cells.

steps.title: Expand CD4+ target cells
steps.instruction: Wash anti‑CD3‑coated wells twice with 1 ml PBS, add 400 µl pre‑warmed R10 + 10 ng/ml IL‑2 to each well, centrifuge isolated CD4⁺ cells at 800 RCF for 3 min, resuspend up to 2 ×10⁶ cells/ml in R10 + 10 ng/ml IL‑2, add 4 µg/ml anti‑CD28 antibody, and plate 400 µl of the cell suspension into each well (final volume 800 µl). Incubate 3 days at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Prepare 5X CFSE and stain effectors
steps.instruction: Resuspend lyophilized CFSE in 18 µl DMSO, vortex, and add to 20 ml PBS to make 5X CFSE; centrifuge effector‑pool cells at 800 RCF for 3 min, resuspend in 800 µl PBS, add 200 µl 5X CFSE, incubate 20 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, then quench dye by adding 10 ml pre‑warmed R10.

steps.title: Expand antigen‑specific effector cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge CFSE‑stained effector cells at 800 RCF for 3 min, resuspend in R10 at 1 ×10⁶ cells/ml; transfer 200 µl to a 96‑well round‑bottom plate as an unstimulated control; add 100 nM HLA‑optimal peptide(s) to the remaining suspension, plate 200 µl (≈200 000 cells) per well, and incubate 6 days at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. For multiple responses, split cultures; for polyclonal tests, add each peptide at 100 nM to the same culture.

steps.title: Expand target cells post‑stimulation
steps.instruction: After 3 days of anti‑CD3 stimulation, remove CD4⁺ cells from the coated wells, count, centrifuge 800 RCF for 3 min, resuspend at ~1 ×10⁶ cells/ml in pre‑warmed R10 + 10 ng/ml IL‑2, plate 1 ml per well in a new tissue‑culture‑treated 24‑well plate, and incubate another 3 days at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Pulse target cells with peptide
steps.instruction: After the additional 3‑day expansion, resuspend and pool target cells, count, split equally into two tubes; leave one tube unpulsed, add 10 µM peptide(s) to the other, and incubate 25 min at 37 °C. For multiple responses, split accordingly; for polyclonal tests, add each peptide at 10 µM to the same tube.

steps.title: Isolate CD8+ effector cells
steps.instruction: After 6 days of peptide expansion, pool all effector wells, resuspend, transfer to a conical tube, and save 200 µl of both unstimulated and peptide‑stimulated mononuclear cells in a 96‑well plate at 37 °C for later analysis. Then isolate CD8⁺ T cells from the remaining CFSE‑stained, peptide‑expanded cells using a magnetic negative‑selection kit and count the purified CD8⁺ cells.

steps.title: Label target cells with fluorescent dyes
steps.instruction: Resuspend each CellTrace Far Red (CTFR) and CellTrace Violet (CTV) vial in 50 µl DMSO to make stock solutions. After the 25‑min peptide incubation, add 1 µl CTV per ml to both unpulsed and peptide‑pulsed cells in 1 ml R10; add 1 µl CTFR per ml only to the peptide‑pulsed cells in 1 ml pre‑warmed R10. Incubate 5 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, wash twice with 10 ml R10, resuspend each pellet in 1 ml R10, and combine pulsed and unpulsed cells 1:1.

steps.title: Set up effector‑target coculture
steps.instruction: Prepare a 96‑well round‑bottom plate. Dilute mixed target cells to 5 ×10⁵ cells/ml in R10 and plate 100 µl (≈50 000 cells) per well (range 25‑150 k cells/well is acceptable). Centrifuge and resuspend purified effector CD8⁺ cells at 4 ×10⁶ cells/ml in R10. Add effector volumes for desired E:T ratios: 12.5 µl for 1:1, 25 µl for 2:1, 50 µl for 4:1, 100 µl for 8:1; add 12.5 µl to a separate well as an effector‑only control. Bring each well to 200 µl with R10 and incubate 4–6 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Stain coculture for flow cytometry
steps.instruction: After incubation, centrifuge the plate at 800 RCF for 3 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend cells in FACS buffer. Optionally add 2–4 nM APC‑conjugated peptide‑HLA multimer(s) for 15 min on ice to assess TCR expression. Then add a cocktail containing BV605‑anti‑CD3, BV711‑anti‑CD4, BUV395‑anti‑CD8 (each 1:100 final dilution) and Live‑Dead Near‑IR (prepared in 50 µl DMSO) at 1:1000 final dilution. Incubate 30 min at 4 °C, wash with 200 µl/well FACS buffer. Do not add multimer to samples containing dyed target cells.

steps.title: Acquire and analyze flow data
steps.instruction: Compensate fluorescence overlap, acquire data on a flow cytometer, and analyze with appropriate software. Samples may be run the same day or stored at 4 °C protected from light and run the next day.
